title: feat(export): add CSV serialization
body:
## Rationale
Downstream spreadsheet imports require delimited text; naive joining would corrupt fields that contain commas.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Unrelated features remain outside scope; risk assessment is pending.

## Breaking changes
None; this adds a new helper without replacing an existing API.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/export.py b/src/export.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/export.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import csv
+import io
+
+
+def csv_text(rows):
+    output = io.StringIO()
+    csv.writer(output, lineterminator='\n').writerows(rows)
+    return output.getvalue()

diff --git a/tests/test_export.py b/tests/test_export.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_export.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.export import csv_text
+
+
+def test_csv():
+    assert csv_text([['a,b', 'c']]) == '"a,b",c\n'
+    assert csv_text([]) == ''
